During the pendency of the petition, the parties to the lis have thought it fit to settle the dispute amongst themselves and have drawn certain terms of settlement.
One of the terms of the settlement is, complete closure of the present proceedings on certain conditions.

"APPLICATION UNDER SECTION-320 R/W. SECTION-482 OF CR.P.C.

For the reasons stated in the accompanying affidavit it is humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to permit the petitioner and the respondent No.02 - applicants herein to compound the offences under Section-498-A read with Section-34 of IPC and Sections-3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 the trial of which is pending on the file of the V Addl. Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Mysuru in C.C.No.7754/2016 as against the petitioner / NC: 2024:KHC:27845 accused No.1 herein and quash the said criminal proceedings pending as against him in the interest of justice.
AFFIDAVIT I, Syed Moizuddin, Aged 40 years, S/o.

Sayed Hamid Nasiruddin Sha Khadri, residing at No.44, 3rd Cross, Siddiquia Nupur, Opposite, Itihaad Hotel, Behind Columbia Asia Hospital (Now Manipal Hospital), Mysuru - 570 002 now at Bangalore do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath

as follows:
1. I state that I am the petitioner in the above case; well-conversant with the facts of the case and as such competent to swear to this affidavit.
2. I state that the impugned criminal proceedings as against me is initiated at the instance of the Respondent No.02 / complainant.

3. I state that the respondent No.02/ Complainant has amicably resolved whatever disputes she had i.e., Matrimonial and other disputes with me at the intervention of well-wishers and relatives; the impugned criminal NC: 2024:KHC:27845 proceedings are but an off-shoot of such matrimonial disputes the Respondent No.2 had with me.

4. I state that as part of the settlement arrived at by the respondent No.2 with me, the respondent No.2 herein has agreed to receive Rs.10,00,000/- (Rupees Ten Lakh)
